confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors use Belfast aggregator and guide figures (Numbeo, Wise, Pint Tracker, Belfast Guide, Expatistan) dated 2024-2026 rather than July 2026 specifically; beer and cappuccino figures agree closely, meal figures vary more. The cocktail rests on guide price ranges and sits about 2x the pint price. No aggregated Belfast glass-of-wine price was found, so the wine glass is set at about 1.25x the pint price with a single-venue cross-check. GBP figures were converted at an approximate rate implied by Numbeo USD-converted figures in search results, not a direct FX lookup. Accommodation anchors are general-knowledge estimates for July demand; no accommodation search or live listing check was made. The FX rate and 2026-11-18 date come from a third-party site reporting RBA data; an RBA overview search snippet showed the same rate without a date and the official F11.1 table was not confirmed, so FX provenance is only partly verified.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink use Belfast-specific aggregated figures, so no comparable-city substitution was needed. Accommodation is a general-knowledge estimate, loosely judged against mid-sized UK regional cities with similar summer tourist demand.
